name: run-scheduled-jobs-linecount
description: server/jobs/runScheduledJobs.ts is the autopilot heartbeat — a ~6k-line god-file of process*/start*Job pairs sharing ./utils/jobRuntime. It is being decomposed one cohesive job-group at a time into server/jobs/*.ts (S3, started 2026-07-16 with leadCampaignJobs.ts). This ratchet drives its line count strictly DOWN so each extraction can only make progress; lower baselineCount as groups are carved out.
minimaNote: VACUITY FLOOR on the SCAN POPULATION, not a ratchet. baselineCount above counts BAD THINGS FOUND, so a scan that stops seeing files finds zero and reports it as progress: a zero baseline PASSes on an empty file set, and a nonzero one prints a stale-high "lock it in" for a number that was never true. MEASURED 2026-08-16: this config matched 1 file(s) (the single file server/jobs/runScheduledJobs.ts). Floor set to 1, comfortably below that, so a broken glob or walk trips it while ordinary deletion does not. This ratchet scans exactly ONE file, so the floor is 1 — a real canary: it catches the file being renamed, moved or deleted, which would otherwise read as its line count dropping to zero. Checked BEFORE the baseline comparison by scripts/ratchet.mjs; a MISSING floor fails as loudly as a breached one. If a real deletion wave shrinks this population, lower the floor in the same commit and name the wave here — never raise it to silence something, never delete the key. Re-measure with `node scripts/ratchet.mjs --measure`.
lastBumpNote: 2026-08-18, FOUNDRY TRANSFER — OPERATING PREDICATE — 5823 -> 5786. NOT a cosmetic trim: the pause-resume worker's BODY moved to server/jobs/resumeExpiredPauses.ts. It had to. Fixing the half-resume (the worker cleared the four pause columns but never restored a webhook-written subscriptionStatus:'paused', stranding a resumed customer outside every background job forever) needed a guard plus the reasoning for it, and adding either here would have pushed this count UP. Extraction is what this ratchet is for: the caller keeps the schedule and the job lock, the work moves out, the monolith shrinks. Locked in per the strictly-down rule, in the commit that earned it.
